name: versus-match
description: Versus fighting (WM_ROM_OUT/versus of rom.test.tsx, rom/versusFixture.ts: one screen with a floor). Player 1, steered by a bot in play mode (its inputs, frame by frame: it blocks the CPU's near attacks by holding away, or ducks a punch now and then, steps in, kicks from afar and punches close every 3 frames, jumps now and then) fights the CPU, which closes in, attacks every 20 frames and blocks; round 1 goes to the time with player 1 ahead (frame 3972: round 2), round 2 ends in a K.O. (frame 7199), and two rounds won clear the level. Play mode gives both fighters' place, health and score every frame.
